import gdsfactory as gf

r = gf.Component()

# 1. Instantiate components with settings
splitter = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
splitter.move((0, 0))

phase_shifter = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal())
phase_shifter.move((200, 0))

combiner = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
combiner.mirror()
combiner.move((400, 0))

# 2. Route connections
gf.routing.route_single(r, splitter.ports['o2'], phase_shifter.ports['o1'], cross_section='strip', radius=15)
gf.routing.route_single(r, splitter.ports['o3'], phase_shifter.ports['o2'], cross_section='strip', radius=15)
gf.routing.route_single(r, phase_shifter.ports['o2'], combiner.ports['o1'], cross_section='strip', radius=15)
gf.routing.route_single(r, phase_shifter.ports['o1'], combiner.ports['o2'], cross_section='strip', radius=15)

# 3. Expose external ports
r.add_port('o1', port=splitter.ports['o1'])
r.add_port('o2', port=combiner.ports['o3'])

# 4. Finalize
r.draw_ports()
r.plot()
